desktop.notes:
• Dashboard time was far too low: any pause over 12 s was dropped. Now 30 s with no mouse move, key, click, wheel, zoom or pan counts as away.
• Minimised or switched to another app = paused (screensaver too).
• Time shows culling / total; Pace = culling time per decision.
